steps.title: Key Context
steps.body: "Macbeth" was written in 1606, early in James I's reign. The play reflects James's interests: witchcraft, kingship, and the dangers of treason.

steps.title: Theatre was for everyone
steps.body: Shakespeare wrote for all classes - high drama for nobility, jokes and action for groundlings. Plays needed to engage diverse audiences.

steps.title: Relevance
steps.body: "Macbeth" explores treason, regicide, and the betrayal of a king by a trusted subject. The Gunpowder Plot was fresh in the audience's minds.

steps.title: Golden Rule
steps.body: Link context to specific moments in the play. Don't just dump historical facts - explain how context deepens understanding of the text.
